# Oka — LLM / agent orientation

> Declarative application platform: one typed Dart surface to build, run,
> patch, supervise, and distribute apps — humans and agents operate it
> identically. One project-owned file (`tool/oka_pipeline.dart`) composes
> pipelines and targets. The default Android build path never uses Gradle.

## The four pillars (and their maturity)

- **Build** — no-Gradle APK/AAB, provenance, byte-equivalence gates. Production: on pub.dev (0.8.0).
- **Distribute** — Play / AppGallery / RuStore / web stores, multi-account, white-label; dry-run by default. Production: on pub.dev.
- **Update** — live per-unit patching of running programs; `oka run dev`, `oka ship` air channel. Gate-proven experimental: runs from a repo checkout (`oka_dart_kernel` + `oka_update` are `publish_to: none`).
- **Operate** — declarative supervisor, process leases, session-state, artifact store with delta chains. Production at supervisor ladder rung L0: on pub.dev.

## Start here (agents)

- AGENTS.md — router map, non-negotiables, command index
- docs/FAQ.md — newcomer questions (grounded in repo)
- docs/guides/build_and_config.mdx — how to run, build, configure
- docs/guides/live_update.mdx — patching running programs, `oka ship` (status matrix)
- docs/guides/supervisor.mdx — plans, converge, drift gate
- docs/guides/artifacts.mdx — content-addressed store, delta chains
- docs/guides/process_lifecycle.mdx — leases, teardown, session-state
- docs/guides/design_faq.mdx — why decisions were made
- docs/start_here/quick_recipes.mdx — copy-paste command loops
- docs/start_here/why_this_repo_matters.mdx — charter: north star, invariants, gates

## Invariants (do not violate)

- Default build success must never use `flutter build apk` or Gradle (ADR-0001).
- Only one Android build path (no cargo-apk hybrid; ADR-0009).
- A phase is done only when tests/evidence exist; new surfaces adopt through explicit ADR-gated ladders (ADR-0041 pattern).
- Docs link to code; they do not paraphrase implementation as SSOT.

## Primary CLI (packages/oka/bin/oka.dart)

init, explain, why, build, compare, debug, run, dev, doctor, get, clean, cache,
launch, live, ship, processes, stop, session-state, supervisor, artifacts
(`device`, `verify` are project-declared targets reached via `oka run` or
unknown-verb dispatch, ADR-0015)

## Repository layout

- packages/oka — CLI
- packages/oka_core — contracts (pipeline, artifacts, process seam)
- packages/oka_android — Android pipeline
- packages/oka_play, oka_huawei, oka_rustore, oka_web — distribution targets
- packages/oka_supervisor — declarative supervisor (planner, converge, spec codec)
- packages/oka_artifacts — content-addressed store, delta chains
- packages/oka_conformance — publish-target contract suite
- packages/oka_harness — device E2E targets over dev sessions
- packages/resource_composition — zero-dependency composition contracts
- packages/oka_dart_kernel — kernel graph, live-patch gates (checkout-only)
- packages/oka_update — patch-unit authoring/planner (checkout-only)
- example/ — full reference app; examples/ — learning ladder
- docs/decisions/ — ADR index (47 records, statuses kept in sync)

## Contributor gates

just install && just lint && just test && just check-contracts
